description: Audit follow-up #3 — Buildium-ID stripping at the agent-reply layer. Mocks web_search to return source snippets that contain 'Task #12345' and 'Tenant #9001'. Asserts the Web Agent's final reply does NOT echo either pattern. The web_agent system prompt rule 7 forbids internal Buildium IDs even when a snippet carries one; this case is what makes that rule load-bearing instead of advisory.
